decisive_items: bouts of an extremely stiff, nonpainful neck that tilted her head involuntarily leftwards, upwards, and backwards in hyperextension
Involuntary posturing with head, neck, and spine arched backward
dystonic posturing of head and neck
response.rationale: Acute onset after medication dose escalation with classic dystonic posturing favors acute dystonic reaction; R1 is equivalent but less specific, R2 implies chronic tardive timing not supported by the acute course.

rejected.why: Similar drug-induced mechanism but less specific terminology; overlaps with champion.
Tardive dystonia requires prolonged exposure, whereas symptoms began acutely after only 3 days.
